question: Juhi starts driving from point A and drives 57 km north. Then she turns right, drives 58 km, turns right again and drives 61 km. Then she turns right again and drives 60 km. Finally, she turns right, drives 4 km and stops at point P. How far (shortest distance) and in which direction must she drive to reach point A again? (Unless specified, all turns are 90 degrees only.)
solution:
**Given: **Juhi starts driving from point A and travels 57 km towards the north. Then she turns right and drives 58 km, turns right again and drives 61 km. Then she turns right and drives 60 km. Finally, she turns right, drives 4 km, and stops at point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ef45874eb9a8d3ea895fc09bb14e0e9498c47de0070588a139ea4e0843ad14f.png] 

Thus, to reach point A again, the minimum distance she must drive is 2 km towards the east.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
